title.narrative: With the incorporation of 32 new local governments, the ?Municipality United for Children and Adolescents? (MUNA) initiative scaled up to 160 participating municipalities?representing 7% of all municipalities in Argentina?where capacities were strengthened to plan, implement, and monitor intersectoral strategies to realize children?s rights. A total of 1.135 public officials and local technical staff were trained, and 295 thematic action plans are currently being implemented and reported, with the potential to reach 5.4 million children (45% of total children). The expansion of MUNA was made possible thanks to the increasing financial contributions from government counterparts and private sector companies.
